args.reason: Cancellation with re-routing; TECHNICAL cause within Aerlink control; arrival delay at final destination 220 minutes triggers compensation with 50% reduction per S5.4.

rationale: S5.1: cancellation within Aerlink control (S3.3) and arrival delay >=3h; S5.4: re-routed and arrival delay <5h for Band B so 50% reduction applies; S10.2: executing the entitlement service figure for compensation.
